title: React + TypeScript + TanStack Query + OpenAPI client
apiDocs: Types + client generated from the backend OpenAPI via openapi-typescript + openapi-fetch
conventions: Generate the typed API layer from the backend OpenAPI: `openapi-typescript openapi.json -o src/api/schema.d.ts`, then a typed `openapi-fetch` client in src/api/client.ts. Never hand-roll fetch calls or invent endpoints the schema does not contain.
Data access goes through TanStack Query hooks (useQuery for queries, useMutation for command actions) wrapping the openapi-fetch client; invalidate queries after a successful command.
Layer as src/api/ (generated types + client + hooks) / src/features/<entity>/ (List, Detail, Edit components) / src/lib/ (auth context, lifecycle helpers).
One list view + one detail view + one edit form per ENTITY; the edit form only submits fields in the action's mutate set.

Realize each action by its operation: create→create form, read/query→detail/list view, update/patch→edit form, delete→delete control, bulk-*→multi-select bulk action, count/aggregate/collection-transform→summary tiles or filtered/grouped list views — each calling the matching API operation from the OpenAPI client.
Optimistic concurrency: read the entity's version, send it as expectedVersion on the command, and surface a 409 as a 'reload, it changed' message.
Lifecycle: render the current state as a badge and offer ONLY the transitions declared legal from that state (compute allowed transitions from the lifecycle in the IR); disable the rest.
Authorization/ACTOR: gate action controls behind the current user's permissions (hide/disable) for UX only — the server enforces; never treat client checks as security.
MEASURE/analytics → dashboard tiles/charts (add a charting lib only if present); SPATIAL → a map (only if present); EVENT → a read-only activity feed.
Everything the server owns (persistence, the full action contract, policy authority) is delegated to the API — the UI calls it and reflects results.
